data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Nissa', meaning 'womb' or 'birth'. This name signifies a gift from God, a symbol of new life and creation. The name Nissie carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nissie usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nissie total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_greek.name: Νίσση

in_latin.name: Nissia
